# hpe_morpheus_library_option_type (Resource)

Manages a Morpheus Library Option Type resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hpe_morpheus_library_option_type" "example" {
  name       = "Example Option Type"
  field_name = "exampleField"
  type       = "text"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `field_name` (String) The field name of the option type.
- `name` (String) The name of the option type.
- `type` (String) The type of the option type (input, select, checkbox, etc.).

### Optional

- `default_value` (String) The default value of the option type.
- `description` (String) The description of the option type.
- `export_meta` (Boolean) Whether to export as tag.
- `field_label` (String) The field label of the option type.
- `placeholder` (String) The placeholder text for the option type.
- `required` (Boolean) Whether the option type is required.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of the option type.

## Import

Import is supported using the resource ID.

```bash
terraform import hpe_morpheus_library_option_type.example 123
```
